reasoning: The icon shows a user profile with a plus sign (add/invite user) crossed out by a diagonal slash (disabled/blocked). It specifically fits tasks about disabling sign-ups, closing registration, blocking friend requests, or revoking invitations, though the simultaneous '+' and '/' modifiers can be visually contradictory and confused with simple 'add user' or 'remove user' icons.
